definitions: An Act of the Parliament of India enacted in 1956 to amend and codify the law relating to intestate succession among Hindus, Buddhists, Jains, and Sikhs.
A legal framework in India governing the inheritance and succession of property for Hindus and certain other religious communities.
examples: The Hindu Succession Act brought significant changes to inheritance laws.
She inherited the property under the provisions of the Hindu Succession Act.
The Hindu Succession Act ensures equal rights for daughters in ancestral property.
